note: ROSMAP-native race (RADC data set 754 codebook; race7 = revised NIH categories, self-reported at baseline). Distinct INTERNAL name because both ROSMAP_clinical.csv AND AMP-AD_DiverseCohorts_individual_metadata.csv use the real column header `race` with different encodings (ROSMAP numeric 1-7 vs DiverseCohorts text); the source-like emitter renames race_rosmap -> race for the ROSMAP file. CDM landing is harmonized via config/source_precedence.tsv (race_rosmap ROSMAP-native wins over the DiverseCohorts text `race` on 3046853). Codes 1=White(8527), 2=Black or African American(8516), 3=American Indian or Alaska Native(8657), 4=Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander(8557), 5=Asian(8515); 6='Other' and 7='Unknown' BOTH land Unknown(45877986) -- an unspecified 'other' is non-informative and collapsed to a single harmonized value while the real code is preserved in the source column. 'NA' is a missing token (never generated synthetically). manual_approval false pending review.
